_host_example_macincloud_._comment: Use "privateKey" instead of "password" for key auth. Values like ${MAC_PASSWORD} are read from the environment at load time so secrets stay out of git.

_host_example_github_actions_._comment: Builds run on a macOS runner. Copy templates/github/rn-deploy.yml into .github/workflows/ and set R2 secrets on the repo. Currently supports distribution: simulator.

_host_example_cua_.name: your-cua-sandbox-name
_host_example_cua_._comment: Builds run on a cua (https://cua.ai) cloud macOS sandbox over the @trycua/computer SDK. Create the sandbox via the cua CLI/dashboard, export CUA_API_KEY, and `npm i @trycua/computer`. Pairs with `rn-deploy preview` for a baguette + cloudflared live URL. Note: cua cloud macOS must be available on your plan.
